zh.pageTitle: WROLP Editor — 一款 Windows 本地文本编辑器
zh.pageDescription: Tauri v2 + React + Monaco 的 Windows 本地文本编辑器。多标签与分组、草稿恢复、未保存行染色、Markdown 预览、PDF 阅读器、图片画廊、版本记录、内置 Git 源码管理与 AES-256-GCM 加密。MIT 许可。
zh.hero_tagline: 一款 Windows 本地文本编辑器
zh.hero_lead: Tauri v2 + React + TypeScript，编辑区用 Monaco Editor。多标签、草稿恢复、Markdown 预览、PDF 阅读、内置 Git 源码管理和 AES-256-GCM 加密，都在本机完成。
zh.hero_meta: Windows 10/11 · x64 · 8.6 MB · 需要 WebView2 运行时
zh.figure_caption: WROLP Editor 打开 README.md 时的真实窗口截图 —— 左侧资源管理器、中间渲染后的文档、右侧文档目录。点击查看原图。
zh.figure_aria: WROLP Editor 的真实窗口截图：顶部是视图切换与标签条，左侧为资源管理器目录树和 git 标记，中间显示渲染后的 README.md 文档，右侧为文档目录面板，底部状态栏显示分支、编码与光标位置。
zh.figure_zoom: 查看全尺寸截图（在新标签页打开）
zh.features_lead: 一个窗口里完成编辑、阅读、对比和提交。

features.title: 内置 Git 源码管理
features.body: 侧栏第四个视图操作分组目录背后的真实仓库：暂存与未暂存改动、逐文件 diff、提交与历史、分支、三栏合并编辑器，以及 HTTPS / SSH 上的 fetch、pull、push，带进度与取消。

features.title: AES-256-GCM 加密文件
features.body: 口令派生密钥的自描述容器。加密另存为、新建加密文件、改口令、移除加密，空闲自动锁定，可选把口令记住到 Windows 凭据管理器，草稿同钥加密。

features.title: 版本记录与并排对比
features.body: 打开后每次手动保存都记下文件当时的内容。任意两条可以并排比对，也可以拿任一版本与当前编辑区比对；只看变更、折叠未改动区段，或直接取回编辑器。

features.title: Markdown 预览
features.body: 源码右侧渲染 GitHub 风格语法、目录与 Monaco 上色的代码块，mermaid / plantuml / graphviz 围栏画成 SVG。文档自带的 HTML 经白名单清洗后渲染，脚本与事件处理器一律不放行。

features.title: PDF 阅读器
features.body: pdf.js 绘制，整篇连续滚动，25–400% 缩放。白纸、米黄、护眼绿、夜间反相或自选颜色；层级书签可逐支折叠，自动滚动按设定速度推进，按文件记住上次读到哪一页。

features.title: 草稿、自动保存与行染色
features.body: 编辑后约 500ms 防抖落盘，切标签、关标签、窗口失焦时立即冲刷。与磁盘不一致的行会被染色：新增偏绿、改掉原有文字偏黄。自动保存落在一次停顿之后，而不是句子中间。

more.text: 标签分组：标签、光标位置与目录树一起切换
图片画廊：整个目录按自然序，四种视图
批量重命名：规则 token 或正则，逐行预览
配置备份：打开与关闭时自动快照，可任选一份恢复
单实例与 Windows 右键菜单集成
中英双语，默认跟随系统
签名自动更新，只提示不自动安装
窗口大小、位置与最大化状态还原

zh.local_lead: 不需要账号，文件读写都在本机。
zh.local_body: 图片画廊只读本地目录 —— 不接图床、不上传、不生成直链。远程同步只发生在你主动执行 git fetch / pull / push 的时候，凭据放在 state/git.json，不进入设置也不进入配置备份。
zh.local_path_hint: 设置 → 关于 会列出完整路径，并能直接在资源管理器里打开。

关闭当前标签（其草稿保留）

zh.stack_lead: Rust 后端做文件、git 与加密，Web 前端做界面。
zh.download_lead: 一个 NSIS 安装包，装完即可从右键菜单或启动器打开文件。

download_steps.title: 下载安装包
download_steps.body: 从 GitHub Releases 取最新版的 x64 setup.exe。

download_steps.title: 运行安装
download_steps.body: 需要 Windows 10/11 与 WebView2 运行时，近年的 Windows 已内置。

download_steps.title: 打开文件
download_steps.body: 设置里可开启右键菜单集成；再次启动会把路径交给已运行的窗口。

zh.update_body: 启动后与每六小时会检查 GitHub 上的最新版本，发现新版只提示、不自动安装。安装由「下载并安装」触发：下载签名安装包后交给 passive 安装器并自动重启。自动检查可在 设置 → 关于 关闭。

zh.footer_tagline: 一款 Windows 本地文本编辑器。

en.pageTitle: WROLP Editor — a small local text editor for Windows
en.pageDescription: A local Windows text editor built on Tauri v2, React and Monaco. Tabs and groups, draft recovery, unsaved-line colouring, Markdown preview, a PDF reader, a picture gallery, version history, built-in Git source control and AES-256-GCM encryption. MIT licensed.
en.hero_tagline: A small local text editor for Windows
en.hero_lead: Tauri v2 + React + TypeScript, with Monaco Editor in the editing surface. Tabs, draft recovery, Markdown preview, PDF reading, built-in Git source control and AES-256-GCM encryption — all of it on your own machine.
en.hero_meta: Windows 10/11 · x64 · 8.6 MB · requires the WebView2 runtime
en.figure_caption: The real window with README.md open — explorer on the left, the rendered document in the middle, its outline on the right. Click to enlarge.
en.figure_aria: A screenshot of the real WROLP Editor window: view switcher and tab strip at the top, the explorer tree with git markers on the left, the rendered README.md document in the middle, a document outline panel on the right, and a status bar showing branch, encoding and cursor position.
en.figure_zoom: Open the full-size screenshot in a new tab
en.features_lead: Edit, read, compare and commit without leaving the window.

features.title: Built-in Git source control
features.body: A fourth sidebar view drives the real repositories behind the group folder: staged and unstaged changes, per-file diffs, commits and history, branches, a three-way merge editor, and fetch / pull / push over HTTPS or SSH with progress and cancel.

features.title: AES-256-GCM encrypted files
features.body: A self-describing container with a password-derived key. Encrypt-on-save-as, new encrypted file, change password, remove encryption, an idle lock, optional remembering into Windows Credential Manager, and drafts encrypted under the same key.

features.title: Version history and side-by-side diff
features.body: When it is on, every save by hand records what the file said. Any two versions can be compared side by side, or either against what is open now; fold down to the changes, collapse untouched regions, or put a version back into the editor.

features.title: Markdown preview
features.body: Renders beside the source with GitHub-style syntax, an outline and Monaco-coloured code blocks; mermaid / plantuml / graphviz fences become SVG. HTML written by the document is rendered after a whitelist clean-up — scripts and event handlers never pass.

features.title: PDF reader
features.body: Drawn by pdf.js as one continuous scroll, from 25 to 400 %. White, cream, eye-care green, inverted night paper or a colour of your own; hierarchical bookmarks fold branch by branch, auto-scroll runs at a set speed, and the last page read is remembered per file.

features.title: Drafts, auto-save and line colouring
features.body: Drafts hit the disk about 500 ms after you stop typing, and flush at once on a tab switch, a tab close or window blur. Lines that differ from the disk copy are coloured: additions green, replaced text amber. Auto-save lands after a pause, not mid-sentence.

more.text: Tab groups: tabs, cursor positions and the directory tree switch together
Picture gallery: a whole folder in natural order, four ways to view it
Batch rename: pattern tokens or a regular expression, previewed line by line
Configuration backups: snapshots on open and close, restore any one of them
Single instance and Windows context-menu integration
English and 简体中文, following the system by default
Signed auto-update that prompts and never installs on its own
Window size, position and maximised state restored

en.local_lead: No account, and every file read and write stays on the machine.
en.local_body: The picture gallery reads a local folder only — no image host, no upload, no generated links. Remote sync happens only when you run git fetch / pull / push yourself, and the credentials live in state/git.json, outside both settings and configuration backups.
en.local_path_hint: Settings → About lists the full paths and opens them in Explorer.

shortcuts.action: Save (an untitled tab goes to Save as)
Close the current tab (its draft is kept)

en.shortcuts_note: Scrolling the wheel over the tab strip scrolls it sideways.
en.stack_lead: A Rust backend for files, git and encryption; a web frontend for the interface.
en.download_lead: One NSIS installer; afterwards files open from the context menu or the launcher.

download_steps.title: Get the installer
download_steps.body: Take the latest x64 setup.exe from GitHub Releases.

download_steps.title: Run it
download_steps.body: Needs Windows 10/11 and the WebView2 runtime, already built into recent Windows.

download_steps.title: Open a file
download_steps.body: Context-menu integration is a setting; a second launch hands its paths to the running window.

en.update_body: The app checks GitHub for a newer release after startup and every six hours, and only prompts — it never installs on its own. Download and install fetches the signed installer, hands it to the passive installer and restarts. The automatic check can be turned off in Settings → About.
en.cta_body: Needs the Rust MSVC toolchain, the Visual Studio C++ build tools workload, and Node.js ^20.19 or >=22.12.
en.footer_tagline: A small local text editor for Windows.
